1. Getting to Gray Beach and the Hive

The Hive is in the north of {wiki:Quirefang|Quirefang}, an island where no regular boat docks. The only known way is through {wiki:Gray Island|Gray Island}, a small island south of Edron and west of Cormaya.
Take a boat to **Gray Island** from one of the ports of {wiki:Ab'Dendriel}, {wiki:Edron}, {wiki:Venore} or {wiki:Darashia} (150 gp): say {key:hi}, {key:gray island}, {key:yes} to the captain.
Go down the hole on Gray Island

On Gray Island there is a sundial, {npc:Scrutinon} and a single hole, **south** of Scrutinon. Go down it. On floor -1 head **northeast** along the underground passage and enter the {item:Water Vortex}.

You appear on the other side of the cave, at the entrance to Gray Beach. Use the {item:Rope} on the spot on the ground to climb up and go **north** to {wiki:Gray Beach|Gray Beach}. To the **northwest** there is a depot and a temple (underground). {npc:Orockle} is in the **southwest** of Gray Beach.

The {wiki:Hive|Hive} is **north** of Gray Beach: to the south is the big Crawler habitat, to the east the Hive's "stomach" and to the north the largest structure, divided into an **east** tower (opens in phase 2) and a **west** tower (opens in phase 3). Both towers have 7 floors and in the west there is also an underground floor.
East part of the Hive interior
2. Checking the state of the Hive
This world change has three phases. The phase change happens at the world's {wiki:Server Save}.
Ask a Guide NPC or Orockle

Ask any {wiki:Guide NPCs|Guide NPC} about {key:hive}, or go to **Gray Beach** and ask {npc:Orockle} about {key:status}. The answer tells you the current phase and how many actions have already been done against the Hive Born.

This is the default phase: the Hive stays like this as long as there are no actions against it. There are **4 tasks** in the {wiki:War Against the Hive Quest} (ask {npc:Orockle} for them), each worth **1 point**. The server needs **200 points in a single day** to move on to phase 2 at the next Server Save.
Enter the east side of the Hive
In phase 2, the **east** part of the inside of the Hive becomes accessible.

In this phase there are **2 more tasks** in the War Against the Hive Quest, worth **2 points** each. **200 more actions** are needed to advance to phase 3. When there are already 200, the Guide NPC says *"Enough to advance even further into the hive."*
If the 200 actions are not done in **3 days**, the Hive goes back to phase 1.

To enter the reward rooms, talk to {npc:Orockle}: {key:reward} and {key:yes}. You spend **50 Favour Points** and he applies a special pheromone to you that lets you through the {item:Hive Gate|Hive Gates} on all floors for **7 days**.
Access to the Hive Gates for 7 days
With the pheromone, enter the reward rooms and take {item:Gooey Mass|Gooey Masses} from the {item:Insectoid Cell|Insectoid Cells}.
5. Phase 3 — the exposed Hive (west side open)

In phase 3 the Hive becomes completely exposed and the **west** side of the inside also becomes accessible. With Orockle's pheromone you have access to more reward rooms with {item:Gooey Mass|Gooey Masses} and to the room of the {wiki:Insectoid Outfits Quest}.

The west side is home to the {wiki:Hive Born Bosses}: {creature:Chopper}, {creature:Fleshslicer}, {creature:Maw}, {creature:Mindmasher}, {creature:Rotspit} and {creature:Shadowstalker}. They can drop special {item:Dung Ball (Quest)|Dung Balls}, worth **10 War Exp.** each in the War Against the Hive Quest.
In this phase {wiki:Ladybug|Ladybugs} can appear on the **ground floor** of the Hive. Take the chance to tame one.

Phase 3 lasts **5 days** and then goes back to phase 1. If at least 200 actions are done on the **last day** of phase 3, it goes back to phase 2 instead. On the last day the Guide NPC warns: *"It is impossible to hold this position any longer, however."*
From the Hive, return **south** to Gray Beach the same way. There you have a depot and temple to restock.
No regular boat docks at Quirefang. To leave, go back the way you came in: go down to the Gray Beach entrance, south of the town, and return through the cave to Gray Island.
On Gray Island talk to {npc:Scrutinon}: he takes you **for free** to Ab'Dendriel, Darashia, Edron or Venore, whichever city you came from.
See also the {wiki:War Against the Hive Quest} (the tasks that make the Hive advance) and the {wiki:Insectoid Outfits Quest}.
